comments.author: Nekos
comments.body:
Even if you dont have pets is a very good option to get easy money
,for each live prey you get 250.

Means 2 crickets,ants or earthworms=250*(8-10)=2k - 2.5k.
And these bugs are free, you get them with procurement.

But if you have all 3, and you go to lisbon at combinated them making mix baits, you get...

2 crickets+2 ants+2 earthworms
8 live prey-c+8 live prey-a+8 live prey-e

Combination get 24-40 mixed baits and the item shopper give you 500 for each one, so..

(24-40)*500=12k-20k for only 2 bugs.
